description.zh: 客户端Token，用于保证请求的幂等性。从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符。
description.en: The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request. Generate a value from your client and make sure that the value is unique among different requests. The token can contain only ASCII characters.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun computenestsupplier withdraw-service --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --service-id service-0e6fca6a51a544xxxxxx --service-version 1.0 --client-token 788E7CP0EN9D51P --region cn-hangzhou
